description.value: The Met Liquor Store is a downtown New Westminster liquor shop located on Columbia Street. It provides beverages and snacks to visitors and touring cyclists passing through the community. A convenient retail stop along cycling routes through the area.

All required criteria and amenities are marked null due to lack of confirmable evidence.
